title: Network lab 8: Capture a link
intro: Two virtual PCs and a switch. Capture the cable between PC1 and the switch and read the packets of one ping.

tasks.hint: Press Start all, or right-click each node and pick Start.

tasks.text: Cable PC1 and PC2 to SW1

tasks.hint: Double-click PC1 to open its console, then type: ip 10.0.0.1/24 10.0.0.254

tasks.text: Start a capture on the link between PC1 and SW1
tasks.hint: Right-click the link between PC1 and SW1 and pick Start capture.

tasks.text: Ping PC2 from PC1 while capturing
Filter on arp, then click the ARP request and read who is asking
tasks.hint: In the Capture tab, type arp in the Display filter box and press Enter, then click a row.

tasks.text: Find an ICMP echo reply and read its TTL
tasks.hint: Filter icmp, then click a reply row.
